q: What carbon data does a Peruvian copper concentrate exporter give the smelters that buy it?
title: Peru copper concentrate: buyer data
short: Emissions per dry tonne of concentrate covering mining and concentrating, plus the copper content, so the smelter can express it per tonne of copper. Shipping to the smelter is usually added by the buyer. Peruvian concentrate mostly goes to Asian smelters, but EU buyers of the final copper ask for this chain.
audience: Copper mines and traders in Peru and the smelters and metal buyers downstream

ul: CO2e per dry tonne of concentrate, with the year.
Grid factor or power contract used.

p: A 25 percent concentrate carries more copper per tonne than a 20 percent one, so per tonne of copper it can look better even with the same mine emissions.
Port to smelter shipping is separate. Give tonnes and route so the buyer can add it.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so a copper product figure can be traced back to the documents behind it. Factors outside India are entered from the official source and labelled.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
